SELECT formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d', 'Asia/Singapore') AS day, blob1 AS kind, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '15' DAY AND blob1 IN ('answer', 'error')
           GROUP BY day, kind ORDER BY day

SELECT blob5 AS quality, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND blob1 = 'answer' GROUP BY quality ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT blob2 AS route, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND blob1 = 'error' GROUP BY route ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d', 'Asia/Singapore') AS day, blob2 AS outcome, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '14' DAY AND blob1 = 'timelapse' GROUP BY day, outcome ORDER BY day

SELECT blob4 AS day, blob2 AS scope, blob3 AS name, max(double1) AS d1, max(double2) AS d7, max(double3) AS d30 FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '31' DAY AND blob1 = 'active' GROUP BY day, scope, name ORDER BY day

SELECT blob4 AS fingerprint, blob2 AS platform, blob5 AS type, blob6 AS message, blob7 AS stack,
                  SUM(_sample_interval) AS n, SUM(_sample_interval * double2) AS fatal, max(timestamp) AS last FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND blob1 = 'apperror'
           GROUP BY fingerprint, platform, type, message, stack ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT blob4 AS fingerprint, blob3 AS version, blob8 AS os, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND blob1 = 'apperror'
           GROUP BY fingerprint, version, os ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT blob2 AS what, blob3 AS client, blob4 AS route, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n, max(timestamp) AS last FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND blob1 = 'legacy'
           GROUP BY what, client, route ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT blob4 AS day, blob2 AS setting, blob3 AS value, max(double1) AS n, max(double2) AS of FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '31' DAY AND blob1 = 'settings' GROUP BY day, setting, value ORDER BY day

SELECT quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(double12, _sample_interval) AS p50,
                  quantileExactWeighted(0.95)(double12, _sample_interval) AS p95, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND blob1 = 'next'

SELECT blob2 AS keyId, formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d', 'Asia/Singapore') AS day, blob4 AS outcome, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '9' DAY AND blob1 = 'apikey' AND formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d', 'Asia/Singapore') >= '2026-10-13'
           GROUP BY keyId, day, outcome ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT blob2 AS keyId, blob3 AS route, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n FROM terminus
           WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '9' DAY AND blob1 = 'apikey' AND formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d', 'Asia/Singapore') >= '2026-10-13'
           GROUP BY keyId, route ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT blob1 AS kind, blob6 AS plate, blob2 AS stop, blob3 AS svc, blob9 AS berth, double1 AS eta, _sample_interval AS w, timestamp FROM terminus
      WHERE blob1 IN ('arrival', 'board') AND blob6 != '' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '3' DAY
      AND timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '11' HOUR
